<title level="1" right="Class Feature 5">[Inventor Weapon Expertise](/Classes.aspx?ID=19)</title>

<column gap="tiny">
**Source** [Guns & Gears (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=98) pg. 15

**Class** Inventor
</column>

---

You develop tricks for using your weapons more effectively. Your proficiency ranks for simple and martial weapons and unarmed attacks increase to expert. If you have a  <%CLASS>INNOVATIONS%3%%> weapon innovation <%END>, you gain access to the critical specialization effect with your innovation.
name: Inventor Weapon Expertise
